pkgmetadata.longdescription:
gitstatus is a fast, standalone daemon that reports git repository status over a small binary protocol. It can be sourced directly as a minimal git prompt for bash or zsh via the files installed under /usr/share/gitstatus.
This package builds gitstatusd from source against the exact patched libgit2 fork upstream pins for this release. The upstream project has stated that gitstatusd and its shell integration files (gitstatus.plugin.zsh, etc.) must come from the same release, since there is no stable API between them: any package depending on this one for a matched daemon should pin an exact version, not a range.
app-shells/powerlevel10k does not use this package: it bundles an untagged gitstatus commit that does not match any of gitstatus's own tagged releases (confirmed by diffing it against this package's v1.5.4 and against the v1.5.5 tag), so it builds that bundled copy itself instead of depending on this package.
